transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. What can each of you report?

transcript.text: I need to raise a critical preservation issue from my infrastructure review. I've confirmed that the customer-support archive is subject to an automatic purge and cannot be selectively preserved. This means that before any decision to release or narrow the scope of the hold, we must create and retain an immutable snapshot of that customer-support archive dated February 14, 2026. If we release or narrow the hold without taking that snapshot first, we risk losing records that may still be relevant to the dispute. I strongly recommend we complete this snapshot before any hold modification is signed.
